title: Intravitreal ziv-aflibercept for macular edema following retinal vein occlusion

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (article <license>: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating the Creative Commons Attribution - Non Commercial (unported, v3.0) License); private record

condition: Persistent or recurrent macular edema after central (5) or branch (4) retinal vein occlusion, previously treated (bevacizumab, ranibizumab, aflibercept, triamcinolone, dexamethasone implant and/or laser); two-centre open-label single-arm prospective trial (NCT02486484; Hyderabad and Beirut, 2015-2016); ziv-aflibercept at baseline, monthly visits for 4 months with PRN re-injection; per-eye table of 9 eyes

groups.description: All 9 eyes of 9 patients (switch to ziv-aflibercept)

series.notes: case 2, branch RVO; month-4 cell is 'NA' (not available)
case 4, central RVO; the month-4 cell (R6C12) is excluded because its ratio to this eye's baseline lies below the range accepted by schema eye.retina-thickness-record-1.0.0
case 8, branch RVO; month-1 cell is 'NA' (not available)

exclusions.reason: its ratio to the eye's baseline is outside the 0.2-3 range accepted by schema eye.retina-thickness-record-1.0.0; the builder cannot represent it, so only this cell is left out

exclusions.reason: counts and descriptors are not extracted

notes: Baseline is the switch to ziv-aflibercept in previously treated eyes; months 1 and 4 are scheduled monthly visits after the baseline injection.

CMT was measured with a Topcon 3D OCT-2000 at one centre and a Cirrus at the other; Topcon values were converted to Cirrus-equivalent values with the fixed offset stated in the Methods (Lammer et al.); the centre and device of each eye are not reported, so device is unstated and the published values are cited unchanged.
Branch RVO eyes are marked with an asterisk in Table 1; the other eyes have central RVO.
Ambiguity resolved: ziv-aflibercept is the investigational agent of a registered single-arm trial whose authors contrast it with standard pharmacotherapy, so the group role is treated.
Ambiguity resolved: per-eye rows exist, so individual series are extracted and the reported group means are not used.
